faq.title: A few useful answers.
faq.lead: Clear expectations make a better first experience.
items: Which files does SKU Bridge support?
The launch version supports Excel (.xlsx and .xls) and CSV product lists. It includes column mapping and a review step before export. The public beta linked above is an earlier version.
Will the output work with every ERP?
Destination systems use different import templates. Review column names, required fields and formats against your ERP's template. Universal compatibility is not guaranteed.
What happens to leading zeros in product codes?
The launch Excel exporter writes SKU and barcode values as text. If a source file has already lost a leading zero, the software cannot reliably reconstruct it; review the original data.
Can I buy a subscription here today?
No. This is a review version of the launch website. Prices are visible for review; payment and customer account activation still need to be enabled.
Are SKU Bridge and MRP one subscription?
They are separate products and plans. This preview shows SKU Bridge monthly or annually and Hamvara MRP SaaS annually.
Email info@hamvara.com or use one of the contact links below. For an MRP demo, tell us about your current stock, purchasing and production workflow.

terms.lead: How Hamvara products, access and subscriptions are intended to work.
sections: Operator and contact

The current website identifies its operator as Mohammad Bagher Yahya Mazdarani, Istanbul, Türkiye. Contact: info@hamvara.com. The final legal business name and service address must be confirmed before selling subscriptions.
Product scope

SKU Bridge and Hamvara MRP SaaS are separate products. Features, file limits, users, support and deployment arrangements are defined for the chosen plan. Demo and sample data illustrate workflows and are not customer results.
Accounts and authorized use

Use data you are authorized to process and keep account credentials private. You remain responsible for the quality of input data, reviewing exceptions and checking an output before importing it into another system.
Prices and subscriptions

The preview proposes SKU Bridge at $12 per month or $120 per year, and Hamvara MRP SaaS at $590 per year, in USD before applicable tax. Renewal, cancellation and plan entitlements must be stated at the live checkout before a purchase is accepted.
Output review

Hamvara tools assist operational decisions. File validation is not a guarantee of compatibility with every ERP, barcode ownership, accounting compliance or the accuracy of information supplied by a user. Keep appropriate source records and backups.
Support and changes

Send product questions or technical problems to info@hamvara.com. Response commitments, service availability, change notice and liability provisions need final review before paid service begins. Mandatory rights under applicable law remain unaffected.

privacy.lead: What this review website does, and what must be finalized for the paid service.
sections: This review website

The preview does not collect uploaded product files or accept payments. Its language links and pricing controls work in the browser. It does not add analytics, advertising trackers or a contact-submission backend. The hosting provider may process routine request logs.
Contact and external links

Email, telephone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and Instagram buttons open the selected service. Information you choose to provide there is handled under that service's own privacy terms. Do not send passwords, card details or confidential product files in an initial inquiry.
Planned SKU Bridge processing

The tested launch implementation reads product files in the browser for mapping and review. Approved rows are sent to the export service to verify access and produce a paid output. A blanket promise that all processing always stays in the browser would therefore be inaccurate.
Accounts and billing

The planned online service needs account identifiers and subscription/payment status to manage access. If Paddle is activated, payment information is handled through Paddle's checkout under its applicable notices. Hosting, subprocessors and retention periods for the online service still need to be finalized.
Choices and requests

Contact info@hamvara.com with privacy or deletion questions. The final notice must explain applicable rights, request handling, retention, international transfers and the appropriate legal bases for the actual service. The operator's full details must be confirmed.
Different Hamvara tools
The links in the catalog open existing tools with different features and data flows. This draft does not assert identical processing or storage behavior across every product.

refunds.lead: A clear route for subscription cancellation and refund requests.
sections: Current status
No real payment is accepted on this preview website. This draft describes the intended support route once live subscriptions are available.
Requesting help

Contact info@hamvara.com with the purchase email, order reference and a short description of the issue. Do not send a full card number, password or security code. Hamvara can help investigate product-access or export problems.
Purchases processed by Paddle

For a future Paddle purchase, the applicable Paddle buyer and refund terms govern the payment process alongside any mandatory rights and additional rights Hamvara grants. Refund requests can use the receipt's support route or Paddle.net. Eligibility is assessed under the applicable policy; no unconditional refund guarantee is stated here.
Subscription cancellation

For Paddle subscriptions, cancellation can be requested through its customer portal or support route. It prevents future renewal charges at the end of the billing period; cancellation does not itself refund an earlier charge.
Rights and final policy
Mandatory consumer rights are not excluded. Any additional Hamvara refund window, trial arrangement or commercial guarantee must be chosen and stated clearly before paid subscriptions open.
